summary: Desktop Nuxt layout component. It registers `headerBar`, `footerBar` and `loading`, renders `.root` containing the `loading` screen (shown while `$store.state.isLoading`), `header-bar`, the `<nuxt>` page outlet and `footer-bar`, and sets page `head()` metadata (title, html `lang` from `$store.state.lang`, description/Keywords/og:*/twitter:* meta from the `seoTitle`, `seoDesc`, `seoKeywords`, `ogImage` i18n words). On mount it adds a jQuery `mousewheel` handler on `body` that scrolls manually for IE10/IE11/Edge 12.

exports.a: the desktop layout Vue component (normalized component exports)
